blocks.text:
Transfer from the lodge to Manaus and onward to the airport. Flight to Rio de Janeiro. A driver will meet you at the airport and take you to your hotel.

After the rivers and jungle, Rio welcomes you with the ocean, bays and green hills. On Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon, you can stroll by the sea, watch football and volleyball on the sand, or stop at a café for coconut water or fresh juice. Sports activities are chosen separately.
